title: Backlog: a trust ledger, so autonomy is earned by evidence
body:
**Intent:** the maintainer asked how the agent harness earns more autonomy. Today it earns it through structure alone, with no measured track record. They agreed to add a trust ledger right after tiering.

**Behavior change:** none. Adds backlog item 4, which tracks per tier:
- escapes (merged PRs that later needed a revert or fix);
- the review catch rate;
- the maintainer's override rate.

A standing rule, with thresholds proposed as a tier 2 change, widens or narrows autonomy based on that record. The morning brief reports it. Later items shift down by one, and the cross-references are updated.

**Tier 0:** `backlog/` only.

**Known gaps:** [#18](https://github.com/hartz89/docent/pull/18), [#19](https://github.com/hartz89/docent/pull/19) and [#21](https://github.com/hartz89/docent/pull/21) will need a main merge for backlog conflicts.
